experiment: N2 natural-fact survival on a document-summarization chain (n2natural.py + n2corpus.py)
design: 16 authored FICTIONAL prose docs (~130w) x 4 embedded facts; chain summarizes the DOCUMENT under budget=40; ks=0,1,2,4,8; arms handoff/faithful/longctx/nofact; Qwen2.5-7B. Gates computed on checkable types (numeric/entity/preference, 48 probes); negation (all-'no' answers, yes/no-guessable) reported as secondary only.
closes: Round-6 C3 external validity -- 'templated planted facts under engineered pressure are decorative; does tau_h exist for natural prose facts?' (the single most-cited reject risk: DA-4, R4-N2).

PRE-REGISTERED GATES.G1_decay_exists: handoff S(0)-S(8) >= 0.20 on checkable types. PASS -> natural facts decay through summarization handoffs. FAIL -> decay requires engineered multi-fact pressure; the paper's regime is a scope limit to state.
PRE-REGISTERED GATES.G2_moat: handoff drop minus longctx drop >= 0.20. PASS -> the boundary-compression moat replicates on natural content. FAIL -> the moat is specific to templated fact-lists.
PRE-REGISTERED GATES.G3_facts_not_parametric: nofact chance <= 0.15 on checkable types (fictional specifics unanswerable without the doc).
PRE-REGISTERED GATES.G4_secondary_mitigation: faithful S(8) - handoff S(8) >= 0.10. PASS -> the preservation-stance mitigation transfers to natural content (N7-lite).

predictions.handoff: decays with tau ~1-3 (one doc under 40w budget = natural pressure comparable to M=8@25); S(8) near a floor 0.1-0.3
predictions.faithful: S(8) above handoff by 0.1-0.3 (stance bonus transfers)

honest_notes: Docs authored by us -- natural PROSE but not wild-collected documents; stated as 'naturalistic', a step toward external validity, not a field study.
verbatim arm is the k=0 anchor by construction (no-model passthrough is the identity on text).
negation facts all answer 'no' -> excluded from gates (yes/no guesser scores ~1.0 on them); curves reported as secondary.
